newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT-JGBs seen firmer,but topside capped at 124.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-JGBs seen firmer,but topside capped at 124.

text.p: The key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract is likely to try for the upside on Friday after strong gains on Thursday afternoon.
But traders said the June's rise may stop below 124.00 due to lingering concerns over higher Japanese interest rates.

"The June is unlikely to jump above 124.00 unless banks change their interest rate outlook and start receiving fixed interest rates in the interest rate swap (IRS) market," said a dealer at a trust bank's securities unit.
Given Thursday's weaker-than-expected April industrial output data, the downside room is seen limited, traders said.
